messages:
Maria: FYI — we saw a 503 spike in eu-west-1 at ~09:12 UTC. rw-large-v1 saturating. Proposing automatic demotion to a quantized variant as an overflow mitigation, with rules per customer tier + region. Thoughts?

Jae: +1 for automation but need clear QoS rules. Do we want immediate swap or a short hold to wait for capacity? Also how do we prevent oscillation? :thinking:

Ravi: Concern: q4 quantized paths can change output length/quality. For chat streaming it might break tokenization/stream continuity. We should surface a header so clients can detect fallback (X-Rw-Fallback-Variant) and opt into acceptance.

Lila: From infra side we need per-tenant fallback counters and a fallback_latency_delta metric. Also tag logs with "fallback_hint" so SREs can filter. Alert if enterprise customers get any fallbacks.

Tom: Console UX — we need a per-route "Overflow policy" panel. Fields: threshold (p99 latency or GPU util), action order (demote -> enqueue -> spill region), hold_ms, per-tier overrides. Also expose historical fallback rate + sample prompts. :eyeglasses:

Jae: Draft policy snippet:
```
overflow_policy:
  enabled: true
  threshold_p99_gpu_util: 0.92
  cooldown_s: 30
  actions:
    - when: tenant_tier != "enterprise" and region == "eu-west-1"
      do: route_variant: rw-large-q4
      hold_ms: 100
    - when: tenant_tier == "enterprise"
      do: enqueue_slowpath
    - when: default
      do: route_region: next-best
```

Ravi: Two technical caveats:
- KV cache warming: switching variant must preserve context; else we'll hit regen cost. Need a fast priming path.
- Runtime kernel mismatch: some quantized variants may not support certain ops (structured output). Fallback should check model feature compatibility.

Lila: Telemetry + rollouts: add canary flag so we can opt-in tenants to fallback behavior and compare quality metrics vs baseline (WER/LL/heuristics). If regression > threshold, auto-disable for that tenant.

Tom: UX note: make the policy editable via API + Console. Show an "impact preview" (estimated cost delta and expected latency reduction) before activating.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline started for feature branch feature/overflow-policy -> infra-canary

Maria: OK next steps: Jae/Ravi prototype runtime hooks + header, Lila add metrics/alerts, Tom mock Console modal, we'll run a small canary (5 tenants) then expand. I'll create a tracking ticket. Thanks all :rocket:
